action.command: echo "=== All HTML pages in deployment: HTTP status ==="; find /var/www/html -name "*.html" | while read f; do url="http://localhost${f#/var/www/html}"; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$url"); echo "$code $url"; done | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print}' | head -40; echo; echo "=== data/ folder ==="; ls -la /var/www/html/data/; echo; echo "=== nginx site config (php handling) ==="; grep -E "location|fastcgi|root" /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/* 2>/dev/null | head -20

tool_call.name: terminal
